conviction_note: Little here decides the print. The reported quarter (ended 2026-09-30) holds essentially no product revenue, because TUDRIQEV only became orderable on 2026-10-01. The release and call can add only about four weeks of qualitative launch commentary, plus opex and cash. On the other side sit a crowded short (26% of float, 12.7 days to cover), calls bid over puts (-15 vol points of skew) and a +13% five-day run into a low-information print. Those roughly offset, so p_up is 49 on an 8% absolute move. The findings sum to -0.2 and the scaled number is -0.16; they agree.
bar: Unsourced in practice. Benzinga's consensus table (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/REPL/earnings-forecasts, snippet only, the page returned 403 and the snippet is dated mid-August 2026) shows Q2 FY27 at about -$0.76 EPS and about $1.0M revenue. Other aggregators carry nonsense revenue bars: EarningsWhispers listed a $28.44M estimate for the previous quarter (https://www.earningswhispers.com/epsdetails/REPL). There is no company revenue guide. Its own approval deck lists 'First Revenue Reporting' as a milestone within six months (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001737953/000110465926092246/tm2622487d1_ex99-2.htm). Every size is capped small on this basis. Last quarter's EPS was -$0.72 against a -$0.72 consensus, per EarningsWhispers.
positioning_check: MarketBeat (FINRA data published 2026-10-26, settlement 2026-10-15): 23,165,699 shares short, 26.11% of float, 12.7 days to cover, up 0.16% from the prior report (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/REPL/short-interest/). That is a crowded short. In the baseline, 25-delta skew is -15.11 vol points (calls bid, 'upside paid'), put/call open interest is 0.11, the 5-day run-up is +13.31%, the 20-day run-up is -0.46%, and the stock is 19% below its 52-week high. The ATM spread is 48% of mid, so the 8.87% event-implied move is indicative only.

findings.finding: TUDRIQEV (RP1) became commercially available and orderable only on 2026-10-01, the day after the reported quarter ended (2026-09-30). The quarter being reported should therefore show roughly zero net product revenue. The thin consensus revenue bar of about $1.0M (Benzinga, August-dated) and some aggregator bars far above that (one carried $28M for the prior quarter) will mechanically 'miss' on headline feeds.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior revenue line. Last print (2026-08-14), EPS was in line at -$0.72 against a 'revenue miss' of $0 vs $28M on aggregators, and the stock moved -1.45%. The seven prior prints have a median absolute move of 3.55%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced. Holders know the launch date, and the August-dated $1.0M consensus may simply be stale. If it were fully priced, the revenue estimates on the aggregators would read $0 for the September quarter, and they do not. The risk is headline-algorithm noise at the open, not a fundamental surprise.
findings.independence: Company 8-K of 2026-08-14: 'anticipates having product in the market within 60 days' of the 2026-08-06 approval (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001737953/000110465926096483/tm2623208d1_ex99-1.htm).

findings.finding: The call will carry the first commercial commentary, covering about four weeks of launch. It will be measured against the company's own August plan: about 200 early-adopter accounts (CA, TX, FL), about 450 accounts in roughly six months and about 1,200 long term. Reimbursement relies on existing procedural codes (no product J-code mentioned), the cost is 'in line with comparable treatments', and administration is intratumoral injection, with imaging guidance for deep or visceral lesions. That workflow typically ramps slowly in the first weeks.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the first launch print, so there is no history on this line. The approval and the $150M raise were bought (the stock hit an 18-month high on the raise in August 2026). The two prints since the CRL and resubmission moved -3.7% (2026-06-29) and -1.45% (2026-08-14).
findings.why_not_priced: No early-uptake numbers (accounts activated, patients treated, orders) have been published since the 2026-10-01 availability release. If the market had a view, the skew would not be call-bid into a print that by construction cannot show revenue. The direction is genuinely open, hence the wide band. The slight negative sign is a proxy: intratumoral or procedural launches (e.g. Imlygic) started slowly.
findings.independence: None from a different source. Simply Wall St (2026-10-10) notes only that the company has 'no current revenue' and that the launch has begun (https://www.webull.com/news/15725339719902208).

findings.finding: Positioning: 26.1% of float is short with 12.7 days to cover (2026-10-15 settlement), calls are bid over puts by 15 vol points, and the stock ran +13.3% in the five sessions into the print. Any adequate launch commentary meets a squeeze mechanism, and a disappointing one meets a stock that has already run.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline does not show a squeeze history on prints. Prior print reactions are small (max 7.32%).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the five-day run-up and the call skew already reflect some of it. What is not priced is a forced cover. At 12.7 days to cover, the short base cannot exit within one session if the commentary surprises upward.
findings.independence: The sealed baseline's skew_25d_vol_points of -15.11 and run_up_5d_pct of +13.31 are a different source pointing the same way (call demand).

findings.finding: Financing looks adequate. Cash and investments were $195.3M at 2026-06-30 plus $141.0M net from the August 2026 offering. Q1 FY27 opex was $68.2M (R&D $49.3M, SG&A $19.0M), which implies roughly $260-270M at 2026-09-30. Going-concern doubt was stated as alleviated, with runway of more than 12 months. Hercules principal of $82.6M is interest-only to September 2029, and the approval extended maturity to October 2029. An S-3ASR has been on file since 2026-08-14, so a follow-on is possible at any time.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The August raise came days after approval and was bought (the stock hit an 18-month high on its pricing).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The money funds a confirmed launch and IGNYTE-3. A third-party page (BiopharmaWatch) shows '5 months runway' using unreconciled numbers, so some retail-facing data overstates dilution risk. A September-quarter cash figure near $265M would correct it. A post-print offering, if any, would most likely price after the 10-28 close, outside the window.
findings.independence: Company 8-K of 2026-08-14 (same filing day, separate document): 'greater than twelve months' runway (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001737953/000110465926096483/tm2623208d1_ex99-1.htm).

findings.finding: A new securities class action (Toor v. Replimune) was filed on 2026-08-06, the approval date, with a lead-plaintiff deadline of 2026-10-05. The 10-Q discloses it, and management may update it in the release or the 10-Q.
findings.why_not_priced: Already public and immaterial at this stage. A reserve would be visible only if the company accrued one, which is unlikely this early.

outside_window.finding: The first quarter with real TUDRIQEV revenue is the December 2026 quarter, which would report around February 2027. That is the real launch test.
RP2 REVEAL (uveal melanoma) is expected to transition to Phase 3 in Q1 2027, and the IGNYTE-3 confirmatory OS readout is expected in 2030.

searched_and_found_nothing: A cause for the +13% five-day run-up: no Replimune press release, 8-K or reported rating change after the 2026-10-22 call notice was found.
Any early TUDRIQEV uptake data (accounts, patients, orders) since the 2026-10-01 availability release: none found.
NCCN guideline listing or J-code status for TUDRIQEV: not found.
EDGAR since the 10-Q: only an 8-K of 2026-09-16 (items 5.03/5.07, annual meeting and bylaws) and Form 4s of 2026-08-19 and 2026-08-24; no October filings.
A clean current consensus for Q2 FY27: only Benzinga's August-dated snippet, with the page blocked (403); ir.replimune.com is also 403.

rejected_candidates.candidate: BiopharmaWatch '5 months runway, high dilution risk' on $195M liquidity and $25M/month burn
rejected_candidates.detail: The 10-Q states runway of more than 12 months including $141M of August net proceeds, and the page's own numbers do not reconcile.
Stale and pre-approval. Post-approval reports show JPMorgan at a $20-21 target and Leerink and BMO at Buy (https://www.finanztrends.de/news/replimune-aktie-jpmorgan-hebt-ziel-von-17-auf-20-dollar/).

rejected_candidates.candidate: July 2026 FDA briefing document doubting the IGNYTE benefit
rejected_candidates.detail: Superseded by the accelerated approval of 2026-08-06; it is not a print item.

baseline_tension: The evidence neither confirms nor contradicts the call skew and the five-day run-up. The print is structurally low-information, and the crowded short sits against the run-up, so p_up stays at 49.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar unsourced: one August-dated Benzinga snippet, aggregators disagree): the revenue-miss finding was cut from -0.5 to -0.3.
Rule 7 (negative against a -15 call skew and a 26%-of-float short): the launch-commentary finding was cut from -0.5 to -0.3, and p_up moved from 48 to 49.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): the money funds a confirmed launch, so financing went from +0.2 to +0.1. The difference from the draft is mostly the S-3ASR overhang, which stays a small offset.
Rule 2 / other: the class action went from -0.1 to 0.0, as it is immaterial and already disclosed.
